text:
mira: Hey team — support needs temporary read access to project `llm-traces-prod` to investigate a customer issue. They only need to run a few queries against BigQuery dataset `redwood_llm_traces` and view a couple of logging streams. Request window: today for ~2 hours. What's the least-priv approach we can use that still avoids exposing raw PII?

sam: +1 on doing least-priv. My quick proposal: 1) create a BigQuery view that strips PII and grant bigquery.dataViewer on that view only; 2) grant `roles/logging.viewer` scoped to the specific log bucket(s) / resource names; 3) apply an IAM Condition to make the bindings time-bound.

raj: That sounds right. For the IAM condition we can use something like: 
```
# time-bound project-level role binding (example)
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member="user:support@example.com" \
  --role="roles/logging.viewer" \
  --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-03-20T15:30:00Z"),title=tmp_support_end,description="2h support access"'
```
This keeps it auditable and self-expiring.

olivia: On the PII/redaction side, please DO NOT grant direct access to the raw dataset. Create a view like `llm_traces_support_view` that excludes or masks `user_id`, `prompt_text`, and any raw attachments. Example minimal view: 
```sql
CREATE VIEW dataset.llm_traces_support_view AS
SELECT trace_id, model, latency_ms, anonymized_user_hash, truncated_prompt, timestamp
FROM dataset.llm_traces
WHERE TRUE; -- ensure no raw text / remove columns here
```
Then give the support user `roles/bigquery.dataViewer` on the view resource only (dataset-level grant on the view's dataset with a policy binding that targets the view).

mira: Good — who should create the view + dataset-level bindings? I can open a PR but need someone from infra/privacy to sign off before we grant access.

sam: I can create the IAM condition and binding if you give me the exact support account and the time window. But for BigQuery view creation, plz loop in raj or a platform engineer to ensure the view can't be easily expanded.

raj: I'll make the view and push it to infra repo. I'll also add a README that documents which columns were dropped and why.

access-bot: Access request created: AR-4527 — requester support@example.com, target project `llm-traces-prod`, duration 2 hours. Approvers: sam, olivia.

olivia: Also add a note in the request that any query results containing PII must not be exported off-platform and that support should only run pre-approved query templates.

mira: Ack. I'll open the PR for the view now and add the request details to AR-4527. Sam/Olivia — please approve once you've verified the view and condition window. :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup: will approve after a quick review.

raj: On it, will follow up in the PR with the SQL and a sample gcloud command to bind the viewer role to the support account with condition.

mira: Thanks all — closing the loop here. If anything changes I'll ping in this thread.
